newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Otter lifts stake in Allstate to 47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Otter lifts stake in Allstate to 47 pct.

text.p: Otter Gold Mines said on Thursday it had increased its shareholding in Allstate Explorations NL to 47 percent.
AllState is the manager and 40 percent participant in the Beaconsfield Joint Venture located in North Tasmania in Australia.
"The BJV is in the process of re-opening the historic Beaconsfield Mine, which produced some 840,000 ounces of gold during the period up to 1914," Otter said in a statement.

"Following successful dewatering and refurbishment of the Hart Shaft to the 375 metre level in 1995, a program of diamond drilling is underway to define the resource left by oldtimers beneath the old workings."

Arising from this diamond drilling, Allstate announced on January 15 that the resource had been upgraded to 1.55 million tonnes at 20.6 grams per tonne of gold (1.03 million ounces contained gold) in the Indicated Resource category and a further
0.57 million tonnes at 9.2 g/t gold (0.168 million ounces) in the Inferred Resource category, totalling 1.2 million ounces of contained gold.

A feasibility study is underway and expected to be completed in August 1997. The feasibility study will define the mining methods to be used to extract this high grade deposit, Otter said. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
